cards.front: Define the trace of a matrix
cards.back: The sum of the diagonal entries. $\operatorname{tr}(AB)=\operatorname{tr}(BA)$.

questions.prompt: Which is NOT a vector space axiom?
options: A multiplicative inverse for every vector
questions.explain: Vector spaces require additive inverses, not multiplicative ones.
